name: Saarbrücken
type: big city; college town; district capital; state capital in Germany; urban municipality in Germany
text: Saarbrücken is the capital and largest city of the state of Saarland, Germany. The city has 181,959 inhabitants and is Saarland's administrative, commercial and cultural centre. It is located on the Saar river (a tributary of the Moselle) and directly borders the French department of Moselle.

depictions.name: Saarbrücken
depictions.text: "Not much farther now. I can smell the petrol fumes from here." — Sean Saarbrücken is the capital of the German state of Saarland and the only accessible location in Nazi Germany in The Saboteur. It is home to the Saarbrücken race track and Doppelsieg Motorworks.
